name_zh: 解对初值的连续依赖性
name_en: Continuous dependence of solutions on initial values
canonical_name: ODE solution dependence on initial data and possibly external parameters
literal_source_title_zh: 解对初值的连续依赖性
literal_source_claim_zh: 解对初值和参数的连续性
literal_source_claim_en: Continuity of solutions with respect to initial values and parameters.
statement_blocker: The title names dependence on initial values, while the gloss adds parameters. The record fixes no equation, spaces, solution model, common interval, uniqueness and regularity hypotheses, topology, continuity strength, or meaning of parameter. Standard sources separate vector-field/initial-state estimates, joint dependence on initial time and state, and explicit-parameter dependence. Selecting or conjoining one would substitute missing mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: the selected source must fix time, state and parameter spaces, their topology/norm structure, the vector field, solution carrier, local domain, universes, and typeclass assumptions.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose an estimate, pointwise or joint continuity, local Lipschitz continuity, uniform-on-compact dependence, or external-parameter conclusion.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve the boundary ledger in scope-map.md.
candidate_scope_not_credited: quantitative stability for two solutions with different initial states and possibly different vector fields
joint local continuity or Lipschitz continuity of the solution map in evaluation time, initial time, and initial state
continuity or differentiability of a solution map for an explicitly parameterized vector field
the pinned IsPicardLindelof local flow, Lipschitz in initial state and jointly continuous in state and time
excluded_substitutions: fixed-vector-field initial-state continuity substituted for the external-parameter clause
parameter differentiability or a variational equation substituted for continuity
global or maximal-flow continuity substituted for a source-local result
an assumed solution-continuity package or projection from it

freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source or target correction, canonical-root selection, edition or errata finding, neighbor-target reconciliation, equation, domain, solution, parameter, regularity, continuity, topology, quantifier, or boundary convention, Lean target, dependency pin, assurance profile, validator, or owned artifact change; independent reviewers and master acceptance remain open.
status_boundary: Self-tested planned intake only. It freezes the title/gloss ambiguity, source-family crosswalk, candidate pinned APIs, exclusions, neighbor boundaries, and open task DAG. It supplies no canonical proposition, source acceptance, exact Lean statement, proof, audit completion, theorem completion, or master acceptance.
